cells.scene: A detective studies a wet umbrella and muddy footprints by an open door, then points confidently toward the rainy garden.
A nearly empty pantry contains only one small loaf and a few beans on an otherwise bare shelf.
A scientifically recognizable woolly mammoth with shaggy brown coat, domed head and long curved tusks standing in a cold open landscape.
A close view of one large elephant tusk extending from beside the trunk, ivory-colored smooth curved shape; tusk clearly highlighted, no detached trophy.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — deduce (v.推断，推理): A detective studies a wet umbrella and muddy footprints by an open door, then points confidently toward the rainy garden.
TOP RIGHT — scanty (a.不足的，贫乏的): A nearly empty pantry contains only one small loaf and a few beans on an otherwise bare shelf.
BOTTOM LEFT — mammoth (n.(古生物)长毛象): A scientifically recognizable woolly mammoth with shaggy brown coat, domed head and long curved tusks standing in a cold open landscape.
BOTTOM RIGHT — tusk (n.獠牙，长牙，象牙): A close view of one large elephant tusk extending from beside the trunk, ivory-colored smooth curved shape; tusk clearly highlighted, no detached trophy.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: All scenes reviewed for exact course senses and crop safety. Deduce uses physical evidence, scanty shows sparse provisions, mammoth is a shaggy Ice Age elephant, tusk highlights an attached long curved tooth, shed shows light emitted by a lamp.
